events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how the local centre is started
events.input: $ sed -n 25,60p app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | grep -iE "wrangler|vendor-sim|dev|start" | head; lsof -ti:8960,8882 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how past runs started servers
events.input: $ grep -oE "(wrangler dev[^\"]{0,160}|vendor-sim.py[^\"]{0,80})" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-234.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-228.json 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find sim and dev server config
events.input: $ grep -rhoE "(SIM_PORT|vendor-sim\.py [0-9-]+[^\n]{0,40}|wrangler dev [^\n]{0,120})" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/package.json cloud/wrangler.* 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -nE "argv|port" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; grep -nE "TANTRA|SIM|8882" cloud/.dev.vars.example cloud/wrangler.toml 2>/dev/null | head

events.text: Re-running the reminders probe against the simulator so this run has its own evidence.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how centre points at simulator

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start vendor simulator and local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && (SIM_PORT=8882 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t234-sim.json python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py >/tmp/t234-sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIM $!) ; (npx wrangler dev --port 8960 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8882 --persist-to /tmp/t234-wr >/tmp/t234-wr.log 2>&1 & echo WR $!); for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8960/ && break; /bin/sleep 2; done; tail -3 /tmp/t234-wr.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the reminders probe against simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect worker error
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && grep -iE "error|no such" /tmp/t234-wr.log | head -3; grep -nE "database_name|migrations_dir" wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply local migrations and rerun probe
events.input: $ npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t234-wr 2>&1 | tail -2 && cd ../app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8960 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8882 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4
